item.title: Projects
item.description:
My former and current projects

Scientific data compression and I/O for exascale HPC (RIKEN R-CCS, 2025 - present)

Development of libraries for lossy compression of scientific data, I/O optimization for large-scale Full-Waveform Inversion, and multi-modal deep learning workflows. Contributed to the community study on the state of practice for lossy compression across 9 supercomputing application domains, published at SC25.

TomoATT : Eikonal equation based adjoint-state travel-time tomography

Worked as a lead developer of an open-source code project TomoATT, which is a library for eikonal equation based adjoint-state travel time tomography, optimized for a use on HPCs (implemented with MPI, MPI-SHMEM, GPU with SIMD optimization, and parallel-HDF5, containerlized with Docker and Singularity). Built up an opensource project TomoATT : https://github.com/MIGG-NTU/TomoATT
